inventive_nucleus: A calibration chamber with pressure equalization valve reduces calibration drift by allowing the device to equalize pressure with the environment, reducing the impact of environmental factors.

claim_versions.claim: A calibration chamber with a pressure equalization valve, wherein the valve is configured to equalize pressure within the chamber at a rate that is at least 10% faster than the rate of pressure change in the environment, thereby reducing calibration drift.
